notes.title: The Horrors of Hammer Of Pain: How to Handle Dangers and New Monsters
notes.content:
[h1]Surviving Among Dangerous Creatures: Flowers, Predators, and Monsters in Hammer Of Pain![/h1]

[h2]Treacherous Flowers[/h2]
The last time I saw them was on the walls and ceilings of caves, but that was a long time ago, and I'm not sure if they are still there. I've never encountered them directly, but it's said that these flowers are very dangerous and feed on the energy of the earth, which gives them considerable strength. Therefore, it's better to stay away from them or destroy them as soon as you spot them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/d625c66d5b2a43271dbdb672197014f733f01b1a.gif[/img]

[h2]Guardians of the Forest: How to Survive an Encounter with a Large Predator[/h2]
Sharp long fangs, massive bodies, terrifying sounds coming from every bush—of course, I'm talking about boars. They mainly live in forests, but that doesn't make them any less dangerous. Just my advice as someone who has seen quite a bit in Arcona and beyond: always stay alert, as at any moment, a huge boar might charge at you, forcing you to drop everything and fight, or run all the way to Riven.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/5c5e3dfe2b47984909d186f01f27a4d173ab4f7f.gif[/img]

[h2]A New Mob?[/h2]
The Spitter is a rather dangerous creature, posing a serious threat due to its acidic spits. At first glance, its attacks might not seem so frightening, but that's a misconception. The Spitter's acidic spits can cause significant damage, and their danger should not be underestimated. If you encounter a Spitter, be prepared for its attacks to become a real test for your life and health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/a99f2d369231dce025ac890c15b107bc040cdb91.gif[/img]

[h2]How Dangerous Is It?[/h2]
However, defeating a Spitter isn't that difficult. Usually, a few precise hits are enough. The problem lies in the fact that Spitters are highly fast and agile, making them quite challenging targets. You'll need to be agile and persistent to successfully deal with this opponent. There are two types of Spitters—large and small. Despite the size differences, both types pose a serious threat, and you should be ready for either. However, with proper preparation and determination, you can definitely defeat these adversaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/f490e490d9722b674a4b90bd468a2626d4fbf833.gif[/img]

Hello, fellas! We are glad to see you in the New Year🎇. In this dev-log, we want to share with you some of the details about our motivation, future goals, and our progress🌈. We also want to hear your feedback and suggestions, so feel free to leave a comment or join our social media to see more of our content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3d71004163a191354a0c7038f90501349de58877.gif[/img]
[h2]What are the new game shaders and features? 🎨[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3925f9e65902a128cc1855d5c443068770773c59.gif[/img]
Prepare yourselves for a visual spectacle! Our team has been hard at work implementing cutting-edge shaders to elevate the aesthetic experience of Hammer of Pain. From spellbinding magical effects to breathtaking environments, these shaders will immerse you in a world of unparalleled beauty and intensity. Feast your eyes on the mesmerizing visuals that bring our game to life!

[h2]What are our future goals and expectations for our game? 🎯[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/147daf322e6a75300673df6edc2bee68fe692396.gif[/img]
Our main goal is to make a game that we and our players will enjoy. We want to create a game that will offer a thrilling and visceral experience, with smooth and responsive gameplay, stunning graphics, and immersive sound. We want to make a game that will challenge and entertain you, with varied and dynamic levels, enemies, and scenarios. Furthermore, we also want to make a game that will have replay value, with different modes, difficulties, and achievements. 🏆
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/4df6e910cda0e562838f2cdd3a821e4d0032cea9.png[/img]
Our expectations are to finish and release our game and to reach as many players as possible. We hope that our game will appeal to fans of action games, as well as to anyone who likes to smash things with a hammer. We also hope that our game will receive positive reviews and feedback from the gaming community and the media. 🙌
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/42ea7171cabe315b81784729a1ee25bc67aad221.gif[/img]
[h2]What are the challenges and achievements? 🏆[/h2]

One of the biggest challenges of our game is to balance the difficulty and the fun factor. We want to make a game that is challenging but not frustrating, and fun but not easy. We want to make a game that will make you feel powerful but not invincible, and vulnerable but not helpless. Likewise, we want to make a game that will make you use your skills and strategies, but also your instincts and reflexes. Not only that, but we want to make a game that will make you feel the adrenaline and the excitement, but also the fear and the pain. 😱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/9f841c2c5d76aac238c57b83da2e7ca6869e50af.gif[/img]
One of the biggest achievements of our game is to create a realistic and immersive physics-based destruction system. We want to make a game that will let you see and feel the impact of your hammer on the environment and the enemies. We want to make a game that will let you destroy walls, pillars, doors, barrels, crates, and anything else that stands in your way. Likewise, we want to make a game that will let you dismember, decapitate, and crush your enemies, and see their blood and guts splatter everywhere. We want to make a game that will let you create your own carnage and chaos. 😈
[h2]Your Motivation Fuels Our Forge ⚔️[/h2]
A heartfelt thank you to our incredible community! Your unwavering support and encouragement motivate us to push the boundaries of game development. Hammer of Pain wouldn't be the same without your passion, and we're honored to have you by our side on this epic adventure. Together, we forge a legacy that will withstand the test of time.❤️

notes.title: Something great is coming 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, little frogs🐸[/h1]
We're glad to see you back on our Dev-log. Today we'd like to tell you a little more about the world of Hammer Of Pain. 
As you may have already noticed, it's the [b]Middle Ages[/b]. But what exactly is this century and where do all the events of our game take place? Read below 👇🏻
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/845a1d4a978800093f67852424df775a71b3e0ae.jpg[/img]
This is a whole continent [b]"Betweenworlds"[/b] where many kingdoms are located. 
Your attention should be focused on only a few of them, because it is there that the bloody events of the incredible game will unfold. Pay attention to [u]Arkon and Riven[/u]. Two neighboring kingdoms that have had many conflicts with each other in the past. 

⚔️[i]How long will the peace between them last this time?[/i]
[b]👑👑Two heirs to the throne, two kings. On whose side is our main character? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/ad7b55d8461ad39adf28713f8c8d947e9ff7ac0a.jpg[/img]
You can find out by watching our trailer on YouTube! [previewyoutube=kBFZ2sKIuMM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Here's the link so you don't have to look for it - [url=https://youtu.be/kBFZ2sKIuMM]https://youtu.be/kBFZ2sKIuMM[/url]
We will tell you a little more about them next time, so stay tuned! 

[h2]LAW, AUTHORITY, PROTECTION[/h2]

No, if you think we're talking about the guards, you're wrong....
Although they are a little better than some thief or brawler in the yard, they are far from being defenders of the law. 
The worst soldiers from the entire army get into the city guard. So don't expect them to be polite or show much respect. But you also need to behave correctly in front of them, you don't want to pay a fine to these drunks in armor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/4b4d8aec4d935e280c282efe0688eeabcdb9472b.gif[/img]

Here's a quick tutorial on how to create one of these lawmen. First, the legs, then the head, and our artist forgot about the brains🧠.

Below you can see the guard already in the game near one of the military camps in the forest. 
Will you take the quest from him? (sorry for the quality of the GIF, Steam no longer allows it🥲)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/9e02fa168d2e56e1b9be0f9b9c362231f06b809e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Large Changes! DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
[b][h1]😎 Bam Bam Bam!😎[/h1][/b]

[h2]Yo! You've probably already noticed these sudden changes in our design!!![/h2]
Well, let's start with a sketch made by our artist
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/c9794c57e548908cdf06672268dd8b969e0feb93.png[/img]
From the moment of design and concept, it takes a long time until the drawing becomes a full-fledged, ready-to-use one. 

Well, the first stage is over, we add more thick lines, make the final outline definitions and add the first colors. In this case, we're going to use a loud red, delicate white, and crimson to create a bloodshot effect and fill this drawing with madness. 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/332551ec42265e4ce497acc905d02c84bc710547.png[/img]

Next, let's move on to the final touches and strokes. [i]Style text + clumsy strokes + paint drops[/i] 
is what we need to achieve the main goal - [b]conveying emotions through the screen. 

[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/5c4fbc2a32088a10198675066eae04d6889ab8bd.png[/img]

Below, we have also made a comparison of the previous design and the current one. Write in the comments what you like best. 
[h3][b]Your opinion is important to us🐸[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3dc15a08da4608203c840be5b9c52f2b4eb47cb8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][u] Left or Right?[/u][/b][/h3]

We hope you like the new design better!
